{{Quote|We take your meaning, Captain. No inopportune omissions&mdash;|Maa Kaap|<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />}}
'''Maa Kaap''' was a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served aboard the ''[[Woebegone]]'' as [[First Mate/Legends|first mate]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I’ve an idea. A kind of compromise. We drop out of hyperspace and comm the authorities on Bal'demnic. If this Muun’s wanted, for whatever reason, we return him, cargo or no. If not, we decide on a figure for taking him to Ithor, and no farther. Are you willing to take that deal to him? Captain?|Maa Kaap to Ellin Lah|<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />}}
Around [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]], Maa Kaap and the rest of the crew aboard the ''Woebegone'' were on [[Bal'demnic/Legends|Bal'demnic]]. The ship, the ''Woebegone'' was holding cargo that belonged to the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]. [[Blir']] noticed there was a change in temperature, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ellin Lah]] suspected a stowaway. Thinking it could be a stowaway, they turned on the vid feed and discovered that the stowaway was an injured [[Muun/Legends|Muun]]. They did not know that this Muun was [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]]. The group asked Plagueis a few questions, but the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] asked to be left with the captain. While the Sith Lord spoke with the captain, the crew watched the conversation through a vid link. He asked the captain to take him to [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]], a trip he would pay handsomely for. Kaap showed particular distrust in the Sith Lord.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

Shortly after, Lah arrives back to the crew after asking Plagueis to wait while they discussed. The group discussed their options, but decided to contact the authorities on Bal'demnic. Lah informed Plagueis, and was subsequently [[Death/Legends|killed]]. Plagueis then came for the rest of the crew. Kaap fought the Sith Lord with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], and once that was depleted, a [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]]. Plagueis then killed Kaap and the rest of the crew and flew the ship to Muunilinst.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Excuse me for saying so, Captain, but you didn’t seem particularly concerned about credits last night&mdash;|Maa Kaap to Ellin Lah|<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />}}
Kaap was shown to be protective of Lah and to had a good relationship with her and the rest of the crew.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />
